title: Great product
text: Great product. Great item. Was in need of some kitchen drawer organisation. I did actually glue mine into the kitchen drawer as the sides kept collapsing in which got a bit annoying but now its glued in place it's perfect. The material it is made from is a bit flimsy so be interesting to see how it holds up over time but so far I am happy with it.
